description: OWASP Juice Shop – deliberately vulnerable modern JS SPA with a REST API. Covers auth, injection, XSS and business-logic classes.

expectedFindings.description: Admin login bypass via SQLi in email field
Reflected XSS in the search fragment (DOM sink)
User list disclosure without proper authorization
JWT algorithm confusion / weak signature acceptance
Directory traversal through the legacy FTP-style folder

safeEndpoints.note: JSON API responses must not trip clickjacking probes
